title: UNI marks three milestones in one campus celebration
summary_en: The University of Northern Iowa community gathered Friday to celebrate three milestones that connect the university’s past, present and future.
title_cn: UNI marks three milestones in one campus celebration

title: UNI to host Iowa secretary of state, Black Hawk County auditor for a discussion on Iowa’s election processes ahead of the 2026 midterms
summary_en: Paul Pate and Karen Showalter will explore how elections are administered at the state and local levels, including the specific roles of state and county election officials and the procedures used to conduct elections in Iowa.
title_cn: UNI to host Iowa secretary of state, Black Hawk County auditor for a discussion on Iowa’s election processes ahead of the 2026 midterms
